claude_proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.fixed
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family fits, but the surface cannot represent an item-cast spell that uses a fixed save DC instead of the caster's spell save DC or an innate ability-derived DC.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast Fireball (save DC 15) from it

claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord attunement qualifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The record can say an item requires attunement, but it cannot preserve the narrower attunement prerequisite that only spellcasters can attune.
